newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's IMSS to seek 50 pct stake in Afore XXI.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's IMSS to seek 50 pct stake in Afore XXI.

text.p: Bowing to pressure from labor leaders, the Mexican Social Security Institute will seek to raise its stake in its pension fund management firm Afore XXI to 50 percent from 26 percent, it said in a statement.
It also said the other 50 percent of the Afore, as the firms are known, would remain in the hands of Mexican investors, among which is IXE bank.

The IMSS said it had requested authorization from the National Retirement Savings System Commission (Consar) to hold 50 percent, apparently cutting the stake taken by insurance firm Aseguradora Hidalgo.
"This decision squares with the wish of labor sector legislators who insisted that there should be an Afore controlled by the IMSS," the statement said.
"The remaining 50 percent of the capital of the Afore will stay under the ownership of Mexican investors, among which will be Ixe Banco."

It was not clear whether that ruled out Bankers Trust, which has been rumored to be seeking a stake in Afore XX1. The IMSS afore is competing with 16 private firms for a slice of Mexico's newly opened-up pensions market.
